D: Smaug attacks Lake-town and armies gather at the Lonely Mountain to fight over its treasure.
P: Serve the mains when the people of Lake-town shelter in the ruins of Dale.
S: Rye crispbread with crème fraîche, smoked trout, dill and pickled onion
Rye crispbread spread with crème fraîche, topped with smoked trout, dill and thinly sliced pickled onion.
Dale campfire damper with golden syrup
Damper bread for the survivors in the ruins of Dale

Damper of self-raising flour, butter and milk, baked at 200C for 30 minutes, torn and served with butter and golden syrup. Rub 60g cold butter into 450g self-raising flour and a pinch of salt. Stir in 300ml milk to make a soft dough and knead lightly. Shape into a round, sit on a lined tray, cut a deep cross on top and dust with flour. Bake at 200C for 30 minutes until it sounds hollow when tapped. Tear into chunks while hot and serve with soft butter and a jug of golden syrup.
Muffin tin pies of beef and onion gravy under puff pastry

Mini beef pies of mince and gravy in shortcrust bases with puff lids, baked at 200C for 20 minutes. Brown 500g beef mince with a diced onion, add 250ml beef stock and simmer until thick, then cool. Line a muffin tin with shortcrust rounds, fill and top with puff pastry lids. Bake at 200C for 20 minutes and serve with tomato sauce.
M: Erebor roast beef and Yorkshire puddings
Roast beef sirloin with Yorkshire puddings baked in a muffin tin

Sirloin roasted and sliced pink, served with tall puffed Yorkshire puddings and a rich pan gravy for the dwarves taking back their halls. Roast a 1.5kg beef sirloin at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C for 40 minutes and rest. Heat oil in a muffin tin at 230C, pour in a batter of 140g flour, 4 eggs and 200ml milk and bake 20 minutes. Make gravy from the pan juices with 300ml stock.
Elvish lemon and herb roast chicken
bird under zest and garlic butter, roast roots, salad, as the elves march on the mountain

Chicken roasted with lemon, garlic and herbs, with roasted root vegetables and a herb salad. Mix 50g soft butter with lemon zest, 2 crushed garlic cloves and chopped parsley, thyme and tarragon. Push it under the skin of a 1.8kg chicken and put the zested lemon inside. Toss 1kg parsnips, carrots and beetroot in chunks with oil and salt. Roast the chicken on top of the veg at 200C for 75 minutes. Rest 10 minutes. Dress rocket and herbs with lemon juice and oil and serve with the carved chicken and veg.
W: Green apple and blackberries under an oat crumble

Apples and blackberries cooked with sugar under an oat crumble, baked at 180C for 35 minutes, with custard. Peel and slice 4 green apples and cook with 250g blackberries and 50g brown sugar for 5 minutes. Spoon into a dish. Rub 100g butter into oats, flour and 100g brown sugar and scatter over. Bake at 180C for 35 minutes and serve with warm custard.
K: Bag End hot spiced apple cider
Warm apple juice with cinnamon, cloves, star anise and orange peel

Cloudy apple juice simmered with cinnamon, cloves, orange and a little brown sugar, ladled into mugs with a cinnamon stick for stirring. Pour 1L cloudy apple juice into a saucepan with 2 cinnamon sticks, 5 cloves, 2 star anise, 3 strips orange peel and 1 tbsp brown sugar. Simmer gently for 15 minutes so the spices infuse, without boiling hard. Strain into 4 mugs, add a fresh cinnamon stick and a thin orange slice to each and serve with a slice of seed cake.

steps.text: Dice the onion and cut the pastry into rounds to fit a 12-hole muffin tin.
Brown the mince and onion in oil, add the stock and simmer until thick.
Cool the filling for 15 minutes while you line the tin with shortcrust rounds.
Fill each case, top with a puff pastry lid and cut a small steam hole.
Bake at 200C until golden, then serve with tomato sauce.

veg.n: Dáin's Iron Hills mushroom and lentil pies
veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled (bake fresh)

steps.text: Dice the onion and cut the pastry into rounds to fit a 12-hole muffin tin.
Brown the mushrooms and onion in oil, add the lentils, stock and soy sauce and simmer until thick.
Cool the filling for 15 minutes while you line the tin with shortcrust rounds.
Fill each case, top with a puff pastry lid and cut a small steam hole.
Bake at 200C until golden, then serve with tomato sauce.

dishes.n: Erebor roast beef and Yorkshire puddings
dishes.make_ahead: Season the beef and make the batter up to 1 day ahead and keep both in the fridge; roast and bake the puddings on the night

steps.text: Take the beef out of the fridge, season well and make the batter by whisking flour, eggs and milk. Rest the batter while the beef cooks.
Roast the beef at 220C.
Drop to 180C and keep roasting.
Rest the beef under foil, then heat oil in a muffin tin at 230C.
Pour the batter into the hot tin and bake until puffed and golden.
Make gravy from the pan juices and stock, then carve the beef.

veg.n: Erebor mushroom Wellington and Yorkshire puddings
veg.make_ahead: Wellington can be assembled up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Make the batter by whisking the flour, 4 eggs and milk and rest it. Fry the chopped mushrooms and onion in the 2 tbsp oil until dry and dark, then season.
Sear the portobellos, then lay them in a line on the pastry with the mushroom mix, roll up and brush with the last egg, beaten.
Bake at 200C until the pastry is deep golden.
Heat the oil for the tin in a muffin tin at 230C.
Pour the batter into the hot tin and bake until puffed and golden.
Make gravy by boiling the stock with the soy sauce and any mushroom juices, then slice the Wellington.

steps.text: Peel and slice the apples.
Cook the apples with the blackberries and some of the sugar until just soft, then spoon into a dish.
Rub the cold butter into the oats, flour and remaining sugar and scatter over the fruit.
Bake at 180C until golden and bubbling.
Warm the custard and serve over the crumble.

dishes.n: Bag End hot spiced apple cider
dishes.make_ahead: Simmer the juice with the spices, zest and sugar up to 2 days ahead and keep it in the fridge; reheat gently and strain into mugs to serve

steps.text: Peel three strips of zest from the orange and slice the rest of it thinly.
Simmer the apple juice with the cinnamon, cloves, star anise, zest and sugar over low heat, without boiling hard.
Strain into mugs and add a fresh cinnamon stick and an orange slice to each.
